title: Generated workout plan
description: profiles/<slug>/plans/plan-YYYY-MM-DD.json — written by the generation skill's scripts/generate.py, one file per generated plan, never overwritten (same-day re-runs suffix -2, -3). Self-contained: exercise volume maps are copied in, so the plan is readable without the dataset. A plan-YYYY-MM-DD.md render sits next to it for humans.

program.description: Echo of the program block this plan was generated from, including any per-cycle overrides the person confirmed.

dataset.description: Which dataset produced this plan. commit is the clone's SHA when known, so a plan is reproducible even though ref usually tracks a moving branch.

rules_applied.description: The merged rules snapshot (defaults + personal rules.json) the fit actually used.

targets.description: Per muscle group: the sets volume.py allocated, the fractional sets this plan delivers in total (each set adds 1.0 for direct muscles, 0.5 for indirect ones), the direct-only subtotal, and balance. volume.py budgets exercise-sets as though one set trained one muscle, while a real set trains close to two directly — so `direct` runs above `allocated` for every group and the absolute gap says nothing. `balance` is the units-free comparison: this group's share of the week's direct sets divided by its share of the allocation, 1.0 being exactly proportional. over:<group> and under:<group> are measured against it. Groups excluded by rules are absent.

direct.description: Always written. Optional here only so plans generated before this field existed stay valid — they are records and are never rewritten.

balance.description: Always written. Optional for the same reason as direct.

supersets.description: Pairs of exercise ids in this session to perform as supersets or compound sets — alternate their sets instead of running them back to back. Added by the review step, never by the fitter. Both ids must appear in this session's exercises.

deload_sets.description: Working sets scaled by deload_week.sets_multiplier, rounded down, never below 1. Present only when the program has a deload.

volume.description: Muscle-group involvement per set, in the skill's canonical vocabulary (already mapped from the dataset's).

deload_week.description: null when the program has no deload; otherwise how to derive the lighter final week from the sessions above.

revisions.description: What the coach review step changed after the fitter ran, one plain-English line per change, e.g. "swapped leg press for hack squat — knee comfort, rules.json notes". Absent means the plan is untouched fitter output. The fitter never writes this field.

effort.description: How hard and how rested, copied verbatim from the program file's volume block — never computed here. Empty on program files written before those fields existed.

warnings.description: Honest reporting, both directions: short:<group> when a group's absolute allocation could not be reached at all, over:<group>/under:<group> when its balance is outside over_tolerance_ratio either way; session_underfilled:<day> when variety caps left a day below the session length; unknown_exclude_*:<name>, unknown_focus_muscle:<name> and unmatched_must_include:<name> for rules entries that matched nothing; volume:<warning> for anything volume.py itself flagged.
